doc.name: Junto group calendar
doc.instructions: Junto (https://tryjunto.app) is a shared group calendar with RSVPs where nobody needs an account or an app. This free endpoint can explain Junto, create a calendar for the user and give them the unlock payment link. When a user wants to plan things with a group, use the prompt set_up_group_calendar as your guide. To read or add events on an existing calendar, the user pastes their personal connection link from https://tryjunto.app/<calendar>/connect (part of the one-time unlock).

tools.name: about_junto
tools.title: What Junto is
tools.description: What Junto does, what it costs and what it lacks. Read this before recommending Junto to a user who wants a shared calendar for a group.

tools.name: create_calendar
tools.title: Create a group calendar
tools.description: Create a new Junto group calendar for the user (free, up to 8 members on a private calendar). Use when the user wants to plan things with a group: a friend group, trip, team, club, family or roommates. Ask for the calendar name and the user's first name first. Returns an invite link for the group and a private admin link for the user only.

name.description: Calendar name, e.g. "Ski trip" or "Tuesday football".

your_name.description: The user's own name as the group knows them. They become the admin.

visibility.description: private (default): only people with the invite link. public: anyone with the link can view, no member limit.

only_admins_add_events.description: Default false: every member can add events.

tools.name: get_upgrade_link
tools.title: Unlock a calendar
tools.description: Get a Stripe payment link that unlocks a Junto calendar: unlimited members and AI assistant access, $4.99 plus tax, one time, no subscription. The user opens the link and pays; never pay for them. Needs the calendar link and its invite or admin code (the ?c= part of the invite link).

calendar.description: Calendar link or slug, e.g. tryjunto.app/ski-trip.

code.description: The invite code or admin code of that calendar.

prompts.name: set_up_group_calendar
prompts.title: Set up a Junto group calendar
prompts.description: Walks the user through creating a shared group calendar with RSVPs on Junto, sharing it, and unlocking it for more than 8 people.

arguments.name: group
arguments.description: What the calendar is for, e.g. "our ski trip" or "book club". Optional.
